content.snl: def-struct(Type.InductiveInfo,struct[enumerate](Type.judge(%语境%,%一族类型声明%),Type.judge(%被声明类型表达式%,Type.Expr),Type.judge(%诸构造子声明%,List(Type.ConstructorInfo))))

values.en: An inductive declaration records a declaration context Γ, a type expression for the new family I, and a finite list of constructor declarations cᵢ : Cᵢ. The context contains parameters and indices available to the family. Keeping each constructor type as a separate ConstructorInfo makes the result-type and strict-positivity checks local to that constructor.
values.zh-CN: 一个归纳声明记录声明语境 Γ、新类型族 I 的类型表达式，以及有限个构造子声明 cᵢ : Cᵢ。语境包含类型族可用的参数与指标。把每个构造子类型分别保存为 ConstructorInfo，可使结果类型检查与严格正性检查逐个构造子进行。
